description: This file defines the 'RemindersService' class which implements reminder management functionalities such as listing and adding reminders using EventKit framework. It handles authorization checks, fetches reminders, and creates new reminders with optional due dates and notes.

classes.name: RemindersService
classes.description: A final class that implements the 'RemindersServicing' protocol, providing functionalities to list and add reminders using EventKit.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches a list of reminders based on provided parameters, including filtering by status and limiting results.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Asynchronously adds a new reminder with specified details such as title, notes, due date, and list details.

methods.name: resolveList
methods.description: Resolves the reminder list (calendar) based on identifier or name, or defaults to the default calendar for reminders.
